guidance.claim: OSAT and PCB have strong order outlook and 5-year revenue visibility.
guidance.quote: In OSAT, the order outlook for both the current year and the medium term remains strong with revenue visibility of over INR25,000 million over the next 5 years.
guidance.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

guidance.claim: Goal is to increase NPD-led solutions to nearly 30% of revenue.
guidance.quote: our goal is to steadily increase the contribution of NPD -led and value-added solutions to nearly 30% of the total revenue in the coming years.
guidance.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

guidance.metric: EMS working capital and cash positive
guidance.claim: EMS business will be cash positive and improve days in years to come.
guidance.quote: You can rest assured that Kaynes stand -alone, the EMS business will continue to be cash positive, and we'll be improving it at least by about 8 to 10 days in the years to come in this segment.
guidance.speaker: Nitin Arora

guidance.metric: Rail business revenue growth and margins
guidance.claim: Rail business is expected to grow 20% to 25% with high margins.
guidance.quote: So rail business, I'm expecting this year to grow by around 20%, 25% because of these coming in. And the margins are going to be north of current 30% plus.
guidance.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

guidance.claim: Expects specific revenue ranges for PCB and OSAT.
guidance.quote: I'm sure and certain we will do a good number of PCB of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and OSAT of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.
guidance.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

reported.claim: Total revenue for FY26 stood at INR3,626.4 crores, up 33.2% year-on-year.
reported.quote: Our total revenue stood at INR3,626.4 crores, reflecting a year -on-year growth of 33.2%.
reported.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

reported.claim: FY26 EBITDA was INR5,741 million, up 39.8% year-on-year.
reported.quote: Our EBITDA for the period FY '26 was INR5,741 million, registering a growth of 39.8% over the same period last year.
reported.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

reported.claim: FY26 EBITDA margin was 15.8% with PAT at INR3,639 million.
reported.quote: This translates into an EBITDA margin of 15.8% for FY '26, while profit after tax came in at INR3,639 million, representing a PAT margin of 10% for FY '26.
reported.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

reported.claim: Q4 FY26 total revenue was INR12,426 million, up 26% year-on-year.
reported.quote: For Q4 FY '26, our total revenue stood at INR12,426 million, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 26% for this quarter.
reported.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

reported.claim: Q4 FY26 operational EBITDA was INR1,937 million with a 15.6% margin.
reported.quote: operational EBITDA for Q4 '26 came up to INR1,937 million, translating into an EBITDA margin of 15.6%, reflecting our continued operational resilience and scale expansion.
reported.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan

reported.claim: Basic EPS grew from INR30 in FY24 to INR54.9 in FY26.
reported.quote: our organization earnings per share basic has grown from INR30 in FY '24 to INR54.9 in FY '26, reflecting the company's consistent growth trajectory
reported.speaker: Ramesh Kunhikannan
